newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toppan to hike capital spending 43% in 97/98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Toppan to hike capital spending 43% in 97/98 - paper.

text.p: Toppan Printing Co Ltd will spend a record 100 billion yen on plant and equipment in the year from April 1, up 43 percent from the current year, and will continue a high level of capital investment until 2000/01, a Japanese business daily said on Monday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the printing firm planned capital spending of more than 80 billion yen annually in the three years to 2000/01.

Toppan is boosting its capital spending in order to expand its electronics division and improve its printing operations, the paper said. Toppan's actual capital spending in 1996/97 was 70 billion yen, it said.
A Toppan spokesman was not immediately available for comment on the report.
